rows.q: Write a short procedure for changing the oil in a lawn mower engine, as a document I can print.
rows.why: no headings to find your way
rows.reply:
MAKE DOC: Changing the oil in a lawn mower engine
## Before you start
1. Turn off the engine and let it cool completely for at least 30 minutes.
2. Remove the air filter cover and take out the air filter.
3. Remove the spark plug and set it aside in a clean container.
4. Remove the oil cap and take out the oil filter.
5. Wipe the oil filter and the oil cap with a clean rag.
6. Place the new oil filter on the oil cap and screw it on by hand.
7. Place the new air filter back on and screw the cover back on.
8. Reinstall the spark plug and tighten it securely.
9. Start the engine and let it run for a few minutes to circulate the oil.
10. Check the oil level and top up if necessary.
11. Dispose of the old oil and filter according to local regulations.
END
